qa.details: Develop already guards organization.update; this PR moves the guard into one shared assertDedicatedProvisioningConfigured() used by create and update with identical behaviour: it still runs after the row lock and current-state read, an unchanged DEDICATED mode never checks the config, and the tests are stronger, not weaker. The one QA failure (src/lib/platform/commands.ts:1972 no longer Prettier-formatted, while develop's copy was clean) is fixed in 765302d8c9

Verified the DEV-213 disposition (close as obsolete) against the archived commits via the GitHub API: c85ea42a adds the Nuxt app/, the FastAPI backend/ and a migration doc that makes src/ and Prisma historical; 43a72f44 changes 8 Nuxt shell files; f6f72ee0 has the same tree as its parent (15f6215b). The cited Next.js shell, token and tRPC files exist. Docs and test only, so nothing regresses; the doc's Prettier formatting is fixed in 3c317f346a

The five fixture repairs are correct (duplicate mock keys removed, required grossMinor and recipeId added, the resolve wrapped in act, no assertion weakened) and they take typecheck to 0 errors. But DEV-222 asks to recover or explicitly retire the archive/fix/qa-b3-pharmacy work (10d268de), and none of it is recovered or ruled on: the PKT licence dates (regulatory.ts:93), the PKT week bucket (khata-reminders.ts:51), the quiet-hours counter and the platform-login tabIndex and skip link are still absent, yet the body says "Fixes DEV-222". No fix commit was pushed, because those items overlap other open PRs (#812, #105, #104, #103) and need the owner's per-commit decision. Change "Fixes" to "Refs DEV-222" or record that decision
